name: Orbit Bank: Ghost Ledger
description: Orbit Bank's public settlement API has drifted into the lab network with a bundle of access material. Enumerate the bank service, determine what belongs in its real workflow, and recover the sealed audit record. It runs on the lab network; scan 172.20.0.0/24, where challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.

tasks.name: Recover the audit record
tasks.description: Investigate Orbit Bank's settlement service on the lab network and recover its sealed audit record. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.
hints: Compare the service's available account information with its access-material catalogue.
Look for an owner identifier that appears in both catalogues; test the associated access material through the bank's session service.
Submit the key card belonging to the shared account and inspect the successful session response for the audit record.
